profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I love buidling things.

Lead Developer on a a multi-stream Dynamics 365 v9.1 solution for one of the nations largest lawn care providers. Recently led a team to deliver a d2d sales app used by 3K+ field agents.

Led a team of 12+ fresh college grads from University of South Carolina to deliver Oklahoma state’s Real-ID compliant Driver Licensing system using Dynamics v8.2 on-premise.

I made an automated crypto currency arbitrage bot for my masters thesis in Java, which can be viewed on my Github(arbitrage project). It uses the Bellman-Ford agorithm to find arbitrage opportunities. 

I paid 82$ in capital gain taxes on my trades with the bot, over a period of 4-6 months. Starting balance was 3000$. You can view the masters thesis here:
https://scholarworks.sjsu.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1655&context=etd_projects

positions.title: Technical Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
SRAM Sales and Marketing (US/EU)
        	-Quotations for legacy and high-speed SRAM/PSRAM
        	-Backlog and inventory management and analysis
        	-Sales forecasting based on past sales history and current market trends
                -Marketing collateral creation: product highlights and new releases in PowerPoint, collaborated with Taiwan and Europe teams 
        	-Verilog, BSDL, and IBIS model database creation/maintenance
                -Product information and problem troubleshooting, worked with engineering department to     create Verilog/IBIS model database for customers

Analog and Mixed Signal Marketing
               -Analog marketing collateral creation and maintenance, worked with Analog team to generate relevant materials
        	-Assisted with merging of product portfolio post Si-En acquisition
        	-Market analysis and product planning: LEDs, Audio Amplifiers, etc.

NOR/NAND Flash Marketing
        	-NOR/NAND flash marketing post Chingis acquisition
	        -NOR/NAND flash marketing collateral creation and maintenance
        	-Product planning: competitive and strategic analysis

DRAM Marketing
              -Quotations for LPDDR, DDR, DDR2, DDR3 product lines: Generating customer invoices with custom pricing depending on quantity and product
